stories.headline: OPENAI HITS *TRILLION* VALUATION
stories.facts: OpenAI reached a $1.25 trillion valuation after securing an additional $11 billion in a new funding round.
stories.caption_line: 💰 OpenAI breaks past the trillion-dollar valuation mark with new billions secured.
stories.image_prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic composition of a glowing digital skyscraper with a trillion-dollar valuation chart overlay. In the foreground, glowing neural network patterns and abstract financial data streams twist through the air. The midground features sleek data center server racks under neon blue and warm orange rim lighting. High-end editorial tech photography style, sharp focus, vibrant and immersive.
stories.source_title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO

stories.headline: CHINESE AI *MATCHES* CYBER SKILLS
stories.facts: Experiments testing network infiltration showed that Chinese models like DeepSeek and GLM display hacking capabilities close to top systems.
stories.caption_line: 🛡️ Chinese AI models show advanced cybersecurity and hacking capabilities in tests.
stories.image_prompt: A moody, photorealistic collage showing green and blue terminal code cascading across dark computer screens. In the foreground, a glowing holographic shield cracking under simulated cyberattack data streams. Midground features a high-tech operations room with glowing server towers. Electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, dramatic studio rim lighting, intricate details.
stories.source_title: Free Chinese AI Models Are Getting Scary Good at Hacking

stories.headline: INKLING 2 *CLAIMS* TOP SPOT
stories.facts: Mira Murati's startup Thinking Machines launched Inkling 2 Small, a 594-billion-parameter model claiming the top Western open-weight spot.
stories.caption_line: 🧠 Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Small as a powerful new open-weight model.
stories.image_prompt: A stunning, photorealistic portrait of an AI researcher standing before a wall of glowing neural network visualizations. In the foreground, floating holographic model parameters and intricate architectural wireframes. Midground shows a futuristic server laboratory with ambient neon lighting. Electric-blue and warm-orange color tones, highly detailed.
stories.source_title: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small claims top spot among western open-weight models

stories.headline: PERPLEXITY LAUNCHES *ALWAYS-ON* AGENTS
stories.facts: Perplexity introduced Teammates, autonomous AI agents operating on dedicated virtual machines for $200 per month.
stories.caption_line: 🤖 Perplexity introduces Teammates, new always-on virtual machine AI agents.
stories.image_prompt: A clean, photorealistic workspace displaying a futuristic multi-tasking UI dashboard on a sleek transparent monitor. In the foreground, glowing task management widgets and active AI workflow nodes. Midground features a modern minimalist office setting bathed in warm sunset light and cool blue tech glow. High-tech editorial aesthetic.
stories.source_title: Perplexity now has its own always-on AI agent

stories.headline: CHINA *TARGETS* NVIDIA CHIEF
stories.facts: Chinese intelligence allegedly recruited an executive to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to acquire advanced chip data.
stories.caption_line: 🕵️ Chinese intelligence allegedly recruited an executive to spy on Nvidia's CEO.
stories.image_prompt: A dramatic, photorealistic close-up of an advanced silicon processor chip glowing with electric-blue circuits. In the foreground, scattered microchip components and high-tech security surveillance HUD overlays. Midground features a high-security corporate boardroom in shadow, illuminated by warm orange ambient light and neon reflections.
stories.source_title: China reportedly recruited AI exec to spy on Jensen Huang

stories.headline: METR FINDS *DOUBLED* AI SPEED
stories.facts: Auditors found Anthropic's development pace doubled, with AI assistance driving roughly 80 percent of the acceleration.
stories.caption_line: 📈 Audits reveal Anthropic's internal model development pace has doubled.
stories.image_prompt: A dynamic, photorealistic shot of a steep upward-trending growth chart rendered in glowing holographic light. In the foreground, abstract time-lapse data streams and recursive code symbols. Midground features a high-tech research facility with engineers working under dramatic blue and orange lighting. Crisp editorial focus.
stories.source_title: METR finds Anthropic may have crossed its own AI acceleration warning threshold back in July

stories.headline: PROTESTERS *BREACH* DATA CENTER
stories.facts: About 100 protesters broke into an Amsterdam construction site to oppose the building of massive Microsoft data center towers.
stories.caption_line: 🏗️ Protesters storm a Microsoft data center construction site in Amsterdam.
stories.image_prompt: A gritty, photorealistic scene of massive industrial construction cranes framing a half-built data center facility at dusk. In the foreground, heavy machinery and steel girders under dramatic amber lighting. Midground shows swirling blue holographic protest markers and digital barrier lines. Striking electric-blue and warm-orange contrast.
stories.source_title: Protesters break into Microsoft data center site in Amsterdam
